form.autoBackupCheckbox: Automatically back up the current profile's data after each collection run
form.autoBackupHint: Auto-backup files are saved in the current profile's exports folder. Choosing overwrite keeps only a single `*-latest.cwtbackup` file.
form.creditAutoCollectCheckbox: Periodically auto-collect the consumption snapshot to keep daily-diff spike detection current
form.creditAutoCollectHint: Defaults to 24 hours. When enabled, the licensing consumption snapshot is collected on this cadence and credit alerts are re-evaluated when it finishes.
